reference.text: Our rule: a change of 10% of this place's usual rainfall every 10 years or more is high; 5 to 10% is moderate.

guidance.recommendation: Past records show rain here holding steady enough that it gives no special reason to change plans.
guidance.disclaimer: This guidance isn't perfect. It is based only on past records, and the future is not certain. Not professional financial or legal advice.
